service      scope   running     at boot/login  unit
gps-tether   user    active      enabled        hammunition-gps-tether.service
gpsd         system  active      enabled        gpsd.socket
time         system  inactive    disabled       ntpsec.service
gps-resume   system  inactive    not installed  hammunition-gps-resume.service

  gps-tether: GPS position for QMapShack and the browser map on 127.0.0.1
  gpsd: the GPS daemon (socket-activated)
  time: the clock
  gps-resume: re-adds the receiver to gpsd after sleep

Linger (user services after logout): off

`hammunition services start NAME`, `stop NAME`, `enable NAME` and `disable NAME` change one. A system service asks for your password once; a user service never does.
